# Fxpad / 환율패드

> An ad-free, offline-first currency converter for travelers. Sync rates once
> from Frankfurter (European Central Bank reference rates), keep them on this
> device, and convert on the plane or without roaming. JPY, KRW, USD, EUR, CNY
> and 25 more.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://fxpad.try-dabble.com/
The rates snapshot and your last amount / currency pair stay in this browser on
this device. No accounts, no uploads, no server storage, no ads, no in-app
purchases.

This is NOT a bank, a remittance service or a live trading feed. The rates are
daily ECB reference rates, so a bank or exchange counter will quote something
different. It is a pocket calculator that keeps working when the network does
not.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fxpad.try-dabble.com/): The converter
- [Privacy](https://fxpad.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy

- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/fxpad): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- One tap "Refresh rates" pulls https://api.frankfurter.app/latest (no API key)
- Rates persist in localStorage (fxpad:rates:v1) and convert fully offline
- Online / Offline status, "using cached rates" note, last-updated time and rates date
- Amount, From / To pickers with flags and searchable names, Swap button
- Converted result plus the unit rate in both directions (1 JPY = ... KRW)
- Traveler defaults favor JPY; Japanese readers start from JPY
- Text size A / A+ / A++
- Clear error state when the fetch fails and nothing is cached
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
